from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np

m = Chem.MolFromMolFile('mol2d.mol')
mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=0xf00d; ps.useRandomCoords=True
cids = AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mh, 40, ps)
print('confs', len(cids))
good=[]
for cid in cids:
    c = mh.GetConformer(cid).GetPositions()
    ok = True
    for b in mh.GetBonds():
        i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx()
        d=np.linalg.norm(c[i]-c[j])
        if d>2.6: ok=False
    if ok: good.append(cid)
print('good', len(good))
# check stereo of good conformers
target = Chem.MolToSmiles(m)
sel=None
for cid in good:
    mm=Chem.Mol(mh); mm.RemoveAllConformers()
    from rdkit.Chem import rdchem
    conf=Chem.Conformer(mh.GetConformer(cid)); mm.AddConformer(conf,assignId=True)
    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mm)
    s=Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(mm))
    if s==target:
        sel=cid; break
print('sel',sel, target)
Chem.MolToMolFile(mh,'lig3d.mol',confId=sel)
Chem.rdmolfiles.MolToXYZFile(mh,'init2.xyz',confId=sel)
